title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-x0i0: fuzz target not updated for Fragment::from_bytes API change
description: Commit 2d43956 changed Fragment::from_bytes from from_bytes(data, &mut tile) to from_bytes(data), removing the tile buffer parameter. The fuzz target at rust/lichen-schc/fuzz/fuzz_targets/fuzz_fragment.rs line 9 still calls Fragment::from_bytes(data, &mut tile) with the old 2-arg signature. This causes a compilation error: mismatched types / wrong number of arguments.
